title: heterotheca aspera
intro: Heterotheca aspera, commonly known as greenthread or rough greenthread, is a flowering plant native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits in treating various ailments, such as fever, cough, and sore throat. The plant is said to possess therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Heterotheca aspera include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and saponins, which may be responsible for its medicinal effects.
